name: f4-resume-after-switch-from-sonnet
about: A conversation that last answered on Sonnet, then /model haiku and a resume without --model: Claude Code runs it on Haiku, the model setting, since the setting haiku outranks a last response from Haiku or Sonnet, so the resume must deliver Haiku's rules with a note retiring Sonnet's (F4, fixed). From Opus or Fable to Haiku, the conversation keeps its model.
